dice_game.rules:
-**Gruumsh's Eye Trio** and take the **POT**!
 -High straight **(4,5,6)** multiplies **x5** the bet! BLOODY RAID 🗡️ !
 - Roll any **Trio** of broken skulls 💀 and take **x3** of the bet.
 - A **Pair** of tusks 🐺 **will return** the bet.

cubilete.rules:
-**Repoker of Gruumsh's Eyes** and take the **POT**!
 -**Poker** (4 same) multiplies **x4** the bet!
 -**Full** (3+2) multiplies **x3** the bet!
 -**Trio** (3 same) multiplies **x1.5** the bet!
 -**Double Pair** returns the bet!
 -**Pair** returns half the bet!
